Bindings for the Adafruit Unified Sensor Driver (Adafruit_Sensor.h).

Provides a common interface and shared types for all Adafruit sensor libraries (DHT, BMP280, LSM303, BME680, etc.). Reference: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_Sensor Install via narduino libinstall --lib:"Adafruit Unified Sensor"

Types

AdafruitSensor {.importcpp: "Adafruit_Sensor", inheritable, byref.} = object
Abstract base class for all Adafruit unified sensors. Subclasses must implement getEvent() and getSensor(). 
SensorsColorT {.importcpp: "sensors_color_t".} = object
  r*: cfloat
  g*: cfloat
  b*: cfloat
  rgba*: uint32
Color data in RGB floating-point plus a packed 32-bit RGBA value. 
SensorsEventT {.importcpp: "sensors_event_t".} = object
  version*: int32
  sensor_id*: int32
  reserved0*: int32
  timestamp*: int32
Unified sensor event (36 bytes). Contains a union of all possible sensor data types. Access the appropriate field for your sensor type.

  name*: array[12, char]
  version*: int32
  sensor_id*: int32
  max_value*: cfloat         ## Maximum value in SI units
  min_value*: cfloat         ## Minimum value in SI units

  min_delay*: int32          ## Minimum delay between events in microseconds
Sensor descriptor with metadata about a specific sensor.
